title: Homogeneous generation of graded sheaf algebras and modules
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $B=(B_n)_{n\geq0}$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules with a commutative unital graded sheaf algebra structure $A$ [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures]. Define $A$ to be generated in degree one if for every $n\geq0$, open $U\subseteq X$, section $y\in B_{n+1}(U)$ and point $p\in U$, some open neighbourhood $p\in V\subseteq U$ has $y|_V$ in the $\mathcal O_X(V)$-linear span of the products $ab$ with $a\in B_1(V)$ and $b\in B_n(V)$. When the structural unit identifies $B_0$ with $\mathcal O_X$, this is the usual generation by degree one. Given a graded sheaf $A$-module structure $M$ on $K=(K_n)_{n\geq0}$ [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures], define local finite homogeneous generation as follows: every point $p$ has an open neighbourhood $U$, a finite family of nonnegative degrees $d_1,\ldots,d_t$, and sections $s_i\in K_{d_i}(U)$ such that for every open $V\subseteq U$, every $n\geq0$, every $y\in K_n(V)$ and every $q\in V$, there is a neighbourhood $q\in W\subseteq V$ on which $y|_W$ lies in the $\mathcal O_X(W)$-linear span of the elements $a_i(s_i|_W)$ with $d_i\leq n$ and $a_i\in B_{n-d_i}(W)$. Empty generating families are allowed. These are generation conditions on sheaves, not surjectivity of section maps on every open.

source.place: Grothendieck, Bourbaki Expose 221, Lemma 3.4, printed pp.262--263: degree-one generation and finite type of a graded quasi-coherent module; sectionwise local spanning formulation. Primary Numdam PDF read online.
